name: Reginald Sly
source:
Reginald Sly grew up in London, but during a vacation while visiting the United States, he ended up meeting the love of his life, Patricia. The two would date for a year and half before getting married. They briefly lived in London together, before deciding to move back to Patricia's hometown in North Idaho.

Reginald Sly had trouble finding work for a while after moving to Moirai. He decided that during his unemployment, he would attempt to follow a dream of his to pass the time. That dream would end up being successful, and Reginald Sly became an accomplished author. He focused primarily on Mysteries, but would eventually start to write fantasy stories much later in life.

Unfortunately these days, he's having a harder time getting around in his old age. After the passing of his wife, Patricia, his grandson, Jackson, decided to move in with Reginald to help out with things around the house.

[Taken from Make It Last: While You Can's Codex Entry]
